title: College Basketball
description:
Tennessee Tech at Indiana
The Tennessee Tech Golden Eagles (2-1) play the Indiana Hoosiers (3-0) at Simon Skjodt Assembly Hall in Bloomington. Tennessee Tech defeated Western Kentucky 97-94 behind Cbo Newton, while Indiana topped Syracuse 83-80 behind Markus Burton.

title: Women's College Basketball
description:
Northern Iowa at Iowa
The No. 10 Iowa Hawkeyes host the Northern Iowa Panthers at Carver-Hawkeye Arena. Iowa looks to clamp down defensively following a 91-79 loss, while Northern Iowa aim to bounce back after falling 76-54 on the road against South Dakota State.

title: Women's College Basketball
description:
Arizona at UCLA
The Arizona Wildcats face the No. 10 UCLA Bruins for an NCAA Division I game in California. Arizona comes off a 74-61 victory over Iona alongside Breanna Williams, and UCLA enters with a 78-42 win against UC Irvine with Sienna Betts.
